summary: Restored scheduling for the active label-matched Woodpecker workers after their persisted no-schedule state blocked the release validation pipelines.

verification.observed: Only the two active workers carrying the required lv3 label were re-enabled; unlabeled and historic agents were not changed.
The blocked push pipeline transitioned from pending to running and completed successfully.
The blocked pull-request pipeline transitioned from pending to running and completed successfully.
GitHub received successful Woodpecker statuses for both required validation contexts, and the release pull request became mergeable.

notes: This was a targeted CI scheduler recovery only; application, edge, identity, and Proxmox runtime configuration were not changed.
The repair was performed after the Authentik cutover release had already merged, so this receipt records the exact live control-plane adjustment separately.
